full_context.description: Experiment: base prompt + full contribution text ($contribution_text) alongside the sibling-key-message list, so the model can ground relevance in the actual source text instead of just KM strings

relevance_gate.description: Experiment: base prompt restructured into an explicit two-step decision (relevant: true/false, then stance), with relevant=false forcing stance=NEUTRAL, plus two new few-shot examples mined from real annotated failures

full_context_relevance_gate.description: Experiment: combines full_context and relevance_gate -- full contribution text plus the explicit relevance-first decision structure

relevance_gate_v2.description: Experiment: full_context_relevance_gate plus an explicit correction for the AGAINST over-prediction bug found in that experiment -- teaches the model that a comment confirming/elaborating on the problem a key message names is supporting evidence (IN FAVOR), not contradiction (AGAINST), with two new worked examples drawn from the actual regressions

relevance_gate_v3.description: Isolation experiment: identical to relevance_gate_v2 (AGAINST-narrowing rule + two worked examples) but with the 'prefer IN FAVOR when uncertain' tie-breaker line removed -- ties revert to NEUTRAL as in the original principle. Tests whether that single line was responsible for v2's regression.

scope_attribution.description: Policy v2 stage 1: scope/attribution decision (whole_contribution_approval / target_specific / mixed_qualified / unresolved). Response schema: policy_schemas.ScopeAttributionResult.

per_target_stance.description: Policy v2 stage 2: batched per-key-message stance for the targets stage 1 marked as affected. Response schema: policy_schemas.PerTargetStanceResult.

stance_v2_one_call.description: Policy v2 one-call comparison variant: scope and per-target stance decided in a single call, for the brief's experiment-matrix comparison against the two-stage pipeline. Response schema: policy_schemas.StanceV2OneCallResult.
